0022600113.text: The Indiana Pacers (1-1, 9th in the East, 3rd in the Central and 1 game back) visit the Brooklyn Nets (0-2, 12th in the East, 5th in the Atlantic and 2.5 games back) in a regular-season game, with Indiana 1-0 on the road and Brooklyn 0-1 at home. Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery) and T.J. McConnell (hamstring), and Aaron Nesmith is day-to-day with a hamstring strain and is a game-time decision, while Brooklyn is missing Mikel Brown Jr. (rest) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Pacers won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 123-94 win in Brooklyn on April 9, 2026.
